JoinTeleVip: Join the Re: TeleVIP channel to be among the first to get updates and new features, and to ask for help in the comments
MarkReadAfterSend: Mark messages as read after sending or tap a reaction
OfflineVisibilityInfo: When the “Hide Online Status” feature is enabled, your online status will not be completely hidden. Instead, it reduces how often you appear as online. You may still appear online when interacting with the app, such as sending messages, reacting to them, or reading messages. Your status will return to offline after about 30–60 seconds. For the best result, it is recommended to enable all Ghost Mode options.
OpenSettings: Would you like to open Re: TeleVIP Settings now?
ApproximateCreationDateNotice: This date is based on an estimate derived from the Telegram ID and may not match the actual creation date.
SecretMediaDeleteMessage: It will be deleted for you and for the sender, as if its timer had run out.
SecretMediaMarkedSeen: The sender now sees it as opened
HideSeenDesc: Read messages without sending read receipts
MarkReadAfterSendDesc: With 'Seen' hidden, a chat is still marked as read once you reply or react in it
HideTypingDesc: Others won't see that you are typing
HideStoryViewDesc: Watch stories without appearing in their viewers list
HidePhoneDesc: Hides your own phone number across the app, handy for screenshots
HideOnlineDesc: Appear online much less often. Tap the note below for details
DisableStoriesDesc: Removes stories from the chat list and profiles
ShowDeletedMessagesDesc: Keeps messages others delete and marks them as deleted
ShowMessageIDDesc: Shows the ID of each message in the chat
SaveEditsHistoryDesc: Keeps earlier versions of edited messages so you can look back at them
DownloadSpeedDesc: Downloads files in larger parts with more parallel requests
SecretMediaSaveDesc: Opens self-destructing photos and videos as normal media so you can save them
PreventMediaDesc: Keeps self-destructing media after you open it, and the sender isn't told. In the viewer you can save it, mark it as seen, or delete it for both
EnableSavingStoriesDesc: Allows saving and screenshots of stories that block them
EnableVoiceMessageSavingDesc: Treats voice messages as audio files so you can save them
HidePinnedMessagesDesc: Hides the pinned message bar at the top of chats
DisableChannelSwipeBackDesc: Swiping inside a channel no longer closes it
DisableProfileSwipeBackDesc: Swiping on a profile no longer closes it
BlockAdsDesc: Blocks sponsored messages, ads in search and the proxy sponsor channel
ShowUserIDDesc: Shows the user ID under the name on profiles
CalendarDesc: The calendar used for dates in chats
RemovesContentSavingDesc: Forward, copy and save from chats and channels that restrict it
TelegramPremiumDesc: Unlocks Premium features that work on this device only
DisableNumberRoundingDesc: Shows exact counts, for example 5300 instead of 5.3K
HideUpdateAppDesc: Hides the client's prompts to update the app
FixTLErrorDesc: Hides the 'TL error' pop-up the client sometimes shows
GhostModeNotWorking: Ghost Mode can't work on this version of the app: %s. Until Re: TeleVIP is updated for it, these are sent as normal. Check for an update or tell us in the group.
ClearSavedDataDesc: Deletes the edit histories and the list of kept self-destructing media stored on this phone
ClearSavedDataMessage: The old versions of edited messages and the list of kept self-destructing media will be deleted from this phone. Deleted messages you kept stay in their chats; delete them there like any message.
SecretMediaSavedTo: Saved to %s. Other apps with access to your photos can see it.
SecretMediaNotFound: Couldn't tell which file this is on this version of the app, so nothing was saved
LanguageDesc: For Re: TeleVIP's settings and menus
